ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity white/off-white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white region covering >90% of the fluke surface; centralized vertical low-intensity black splotch extending from the peduncle base toward the notch; narrow low-intensity perimeter banding on the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 45 degrees; vertical depth relative to lobe tips is significant (approx. 1/6th of fluke height).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous trailing boundary; characterized by jagged peaks and varying pixel-depth valleys, particularly prominent on the inner lobes near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve from the peduncle junction to the mid-lobe, transitioning to an upward convex sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distribution of 18-22 discrete circular high-contrast clusters (tan/orange centers with dark perimeters) scattered across the white ventral surface, representing localized surface interruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, low-intensity horizontal pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants of the lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of raised, brownish-grey calcified protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized heavily on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical dark-pixel bifurcation extending from the peduncle attachment point towards the median notch, bisecting the lower half of the fluke surface.
